best_match.fbbt_term: immature adult antennal lobe projection neuron DA1 lPN
best_match.fbbt_definition: Transcriptional clusters corresponding to this cell type were identified in single-cell RNA-seq data from pupal stages (Li et al., 2017; Xie et al., 2021). At 24h APF, the corresponding transcriptional cluster was identified using intersections between GH146-GAL4 and drivers for newly identified marker genes (Li et al., 2017). Mz19-GAL4-labelled cells of this type were followed from 24h APF to adulthood (Li et al., 2017). Clusters at other stages were matched to it by Xie et al. (2021), based on shared differentially expressed genes and marker expression. At 24h APF, these cells form two transcriptional clusters, with fru expression only detected in the larger cluster (Li et al., 2017). DA1 lPNs are born in two time windows separated by more than 24 hours, which may contribute to this heterogeneity (Li et al., 2017). Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult antennal lobe projection neuron DA1 lPN (Xie et al., 2021).

justification: The fru- subset of DA1 lPNs; FBbt has no fru+ / fru- DA1 subtypes. Up to the pupal stage the immature or pupal term is used (curator); FBbt #2220, release 2026-11-02. Lineage: the authors' per-cell `lineage` for this type in the main analysis: lPN 102.
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053697 immature adult antennal lobe projection neuron DA1 lPN (broad match).
